definitions.active_guild: A guild qualifies as active if, during the window, it has at least one non-skipped raid event, OR at least one loot award, OR at least five approved loot lists. A raid_events row with is_skipped true is excluded. An approved list counts when COALESCE(reviewed_at, submitted_at) falls inside the window.
definitions.raiders: Raiders are counted as distinct characters holding an approved list inside the window. No alt de-duplication is applied; this is a character count, not a person count.
